newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Costa Mesa, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Costa Mesa, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the City of Costa Mesa, California, intends to sell not to exceed $12,000,000 principal amount of Certificates of Participation, (1997 Public Parking Refunding Project) Evidencing Direct, Undivided Fractional Interests of Owners thereof in Lease Payments to be Made by the City of Costa Mesa, California as Rental for Certain Property Pursuant to a Lease Agreement with the Center Tower Associates LLC at public sale. Bids will be received via facsimile only on:

at 10:00 a.m., Pacific Daylight Savings Time, at the offices of Rod Gunn Associates, Inc., 3010 Old Ranch Parkway, Suite 330, Seal Beach, CA 90740, telephone (562) 598-7677. The Notice Inviting Bids and the Preliminary Official Statement pertaining to the Certificates are being prepared and may be obtained from Rod Gunn Associates, Inc. at the address and telephone number listed above.
